content:
Special Containment Procedures:: SCP-002 is to remain connected to a suitable power supply at all times, to keep it in what appears to be a recharging mode...

Description:: SCP-002 resembles a tumorous, fleshy growth with a volume of roughly 60 m³ (or 2000 ft³)...

Special Containment Procedures:: SCP-003 is to be maintained at a constant temperature of no less than 35°C and ideally kept above 100°C...

Description:: SCP-003 consists of two related components of separate origin, referred to as SCP-003-1 and SCP-003-2...

Special Containment Procedures:: When handling items SCP-004-2 through SCP-004-13, proper procedure is vital...

Description:: SCP-004 consists of an old wooden barn door (SCP-004-1) and a set of twelve rusted steel keys...

Special Containment Procedures:: SCP-005 poses no immediate risk in any direct sense...

Description:: SCP-005 resembles an ornate key, displaying the characteristics of a typical mass produced key used in the 1920s...

Special Containment Procedures:: A certain level of secrecy is necessary regarding the object's existence and properties...

Description:: SCP-006 is a very small spring located 60 km west of Astrakhan. The liquid emitted has the unusual property of "health"...
